notes.en: Current registration page (fetched 2026-10-09): recent (within 6 months) colour bareheaded official photo, white background preferred; JPG; 50–500 KB. No hats, headscarves, hair bands, or sunglasses except for religious reasons; no over-editing, Photoshop, or AI alteration. Pixel dimensions, print millimetres, DPI, and head ratio are not stated on that page. An older HSK candidate handbook on the same domain stated a 100 KB upper limit and 40 mm × 30 mm paper photos; those figures were not used here because they conflict with the current page. Status is needs-review for that conflict and the missing dimensions.
notes.zh: 现行报名页（2026-10-09 核对）：近 6 个月内彩色免冠证件照，白底为宜；JPG；50–500 KB。除宗教原因外不得戴帽、头巾、发带、墨镜；不得过度修图、PS 或 AI 改图。该页未写像素、印刷毫米、DPI 与头部比例。同站旧版考生手册曾写 100 KB 上限与 40 mm × 30 mm 纸质照，与现行页冲突，本条未采用。因冲突及缺尺寸，标为 needs-review。
